title: Looker Instances Expose Authentication Types
summary: Looker instances now expose their configured authentication types, including Google Auth and Workforce Identity Federation, through a new `authType` field. This provides clearer insight into instance security configurations.
details: The `Instance` resource now includes an optional `authType` field, which references a new `AuthType` schema. This schema details whether `googleAuthEnabled` and `workforceAuthEnabled` are active for the instance. Developers can now programmatically inspect or potentially configure these authentication settings, offering more control over how users access their Looker environments.
